phase: Ablation. v29 is v25 minus the sentence telling the model not to add outings. The primary outcome is the event-level zone share, which has a standard error near 0.015 - the cell-level binary used in v4/v5 had a placebo swing of 0.094 and could not resolve anything.
primary: Share of planned events anchored at a neighbourhood zone. It sat at 0.105 in every arm of v3, v4 and v5, and 37 of 96 plans never left home. Plans are not short of slots - they average 9 of a possible 10 - so this asks whether the guard is what pins the behaviour or the model is.
limitations: This is an ablation to locate the constraint, not a proposed final prompt.
Removing a guard can inflate spending. That cost is measured here, not assumed away.
Twelve people, four seeds. Precision for these twelve, not generalisation.
A higher zone share is not by itself an improvement: it must not come with padded activity counts.
preflight: 277 unit checks passed including 6 new resource-gate regressions. Source, v25 and asset_transaction_v7 unchanged from the previous round.
selection: Closed pair fixed before the run (experiments/v6/prompt_v6.md). v29 is v25 with exactly one sentence deleted and nothing added; enforced by test_outing_guard_ablation.py.
